settings.label: Store phone number
settings.info: Shown in the header top bar and the mobile menu.

settings.content: Shown as icons in the footer. An icon only appears when its link is filled in.
Applies to product cards everywhere: home page, collection pages and search results.

settings.label: Color option names
settings.info: Product option names treated as colors. Separate with commas.

settings.label: Custom swatch colors
settings.info: One per line, "Name: color", e.g. "Sand: #d8c3a0". Adds to or overrides the built-in list (Cream, Charcoal, Camel, Sage…). Patterns like "Black Floral" use their first color word.

settings.label: Size option names
settings.info: Product option names treated as sizes. Separate with commas.

settings.label: Show quick actions on cards
settings.info: Floating buttons on the product image: on hover on computers, always on touch screens.

settings.label: Add to cart button
settings.info: Products with options (size, color…) open a quick-add popup to choose them first.

settings.label: Floating compare button
settings.info: Shown at the side of the screen once a product is added to compare. Opens the compare page (/pages/compare) in a new tab.

settings.content: The theme's sign-in / sign-up forms and account pages only work with legacy customer accounts (Shopify admin > Settings > Customer accounts). New customer accounts always use Shopify's own sign-in page.

settings.label: Sign-in method
settings.info: Must match Settings > Customer accounts. Shopify page: the popup shows a "Continue to sign in" button. Theme forms: sign-in and sign-up happen inside the popup.

settings.label: Wishlist for signed-in customers only
settings.info: Signed-out shoppers who tap ♡ or open the wishlist see the sign-in popup.

settings.label: Side panel image
settings.info: Optional. Shown behind the dark side panel. 900 × 1200 px recommended.

settings.label: Side panel heading
settings.info: Leave empty to use the translated default ("Your style, saved.").

settings.label: Side panel text
settings.info: Leave empty to use the translated default.

settings.label: Show member perks
settings.info: Wishlist, faster checkout and order tracking.
